#### Merge data
```{r merge all data}

Idents(d58_ctrl_org) <- "sample"
Idents(d58_cocul_org) <- "sample"
Idents(organoid_d3_15_30) <- "sample"

merged <- merge(organoid_d3_15_30, list(d58_cocul_org, d58_ctrl_org))
merged <- NormalizeData(merged) %>%
  PercentageFeatureSet("^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt")

```

#### QC and integration
```{r check QC pre-filtering}

# reorder the samples in the metadata to appear in the order desired by us
org_cocult_levels <- factor(c("ORG-d3-ctrl","ORG-d15-ctrl","ORG-d30-ctrl","ORG-d58-ctrl", "ORG-d3-cocul","ORG-d15-cocul", "ORG-d30-cocul","ORG-d58-cocul"))
merged$sample <- factor(merged$sample, levels = org_cocult_levels)
Idents(merged) <- "sample"
# generate color palette based on vintage_cols palette
col_sample <-setNames(c(c("#94D2BD","#58B6AC", "#026D7D", "#002C3D", "#D9BE6D", "#E69000", "#C73E04", "#861D21")), org_cocult_levels)

pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/nFeature_pre-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/nCount_pre-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nCount_RNA"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/percent.mt_pre-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("percent.mt"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

```

```{r filter cells and filtering}

# subset cells based on QC metrics 
org_d3_ctrl <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "ORG-d3-ctrl" & nCount_RNA < 50000)
org_d15_ctrl <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "ORG-d15-ctrl" & nCount_RNA < 35000)
org_d30_ctrl <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "ORG-d30-ctrl" & nCount_RNA < 45000)
org_d58_ctrl <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "ORG-d58-ctrl" & nFeature_RNA > 1800 & nFeature_RNA < 5000 & nCount_RNA < 20000 & percent.mt < 15)
org_d3_cocul <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "ORG-d3-cocul" & nCount_RNA < 35000)
org_d15_cocul <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "ORG-d15-cocul" & nCount_RNA < 35000)
org_d30_cocul <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "ORG-d30-cocul" & nCount_RNA < 45000)
org_d58_cocul <- subset(merged, subset = sample == "ORG-d58-cocul" & nFeature_RNA > 1800 & nFeature_RNA < 5000 & nCount_RNA < 22000 & percent.mt < 15)

# merge
seurat <- merge(org_d3_ctrl, list(org_d15_ctrl, org_d30_ctrl, org_d58_ctrl, org_d3_cocul, org_d15_cocul, org_d30_cocul, org_d58_cocul))

```

```{r check QC post-filtering}

# reorder the samples in the metadata to appear in the order desired by us
Idents(seurat) <- "sample"
org_cocult_levels <- factor(c("ORG-d3-ctrl","ORG-d15-ctrl","ORG-d30-ctrl","ORG-d58-ctrl", "ORG-d3-cocul","ORG-d15-cocul", "ORG-d30-cocul","ORG-d58-cocul"))
seurat$sample <- factor(seurat$sample, levels = org_cocult_levels)

# plot
pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/nFeature_post-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(seurat, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/nCount_post-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(seurat, features = c("nCount_RNA"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/percent.mt_post-QC.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
VlnPlot(seurat, features = c("percent.mt"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

```

```{r pre-process and integrate}

seurat <- NormalizeData(seurat) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000) %>%
  CellCycleScoring(g2m.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes, s.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes)
blacklist <- c(unlist(cc.genes.updated.2019), grep("^MT-", rownames(seurat), value=T), read.table("/home/marinani/Scripts/Databases/Gene_lists/RPgenes_bak.txt")[,1])
VariableFeatures(seurat) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(seurat), blacklist)
seurat <- ScaleData(seurat, vars.to.regress = c("G2M.Score","S.Score", "percent.mt", "nFeature_RNA")) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 30, verbose=F) 

library(simspec)
seurat <- cluster_sim_spectrum(seurat, label_tag="sample", cluster_resolution = 1)
seurat <- RunUMAP(seurat, reduction="css", dims=1:ncol(Embeddings(seurat,"css")), reduction.name="umap_css", reduction.key="UMAPCSS_", seed = 30)

seurat <- FindNeighbors(seurat, reduction="css", dims=1:ncol(Embeddings(seurat,"css"))) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.2) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.3) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.4) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.5) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.6) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.8) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 10)

```
```{r find cluster markers}

Idents(seurat) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.3"

table(seurat$sample, seurat$RNA_snn_res.0.3)

cl_markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = log(1.2))
  
top2_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(n = 2, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top5_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 5, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top10_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 10, order_by = avg_log2FC)
top50_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>%  slice_max(n = 50, order_by = avg_log2FC)

top_cl_markers <- cl_markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
     arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE)

write.csv(top_cl_markers, "Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/top_cl_markers.csv")
write.csv(top50_cl_markers, "Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/top50_cl_markers.csv")
```
